notes.title: Multiplayer and new models
notes.content:
[h2]New models[/h2]

Two new models of warriors have been added to the game, which will diversify your gameplay, namely-archer Seidman.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40311623/2526567032000a9c8d2c4d733581f2a4ed87761b.png[/img]

These are ranged fighters who have silent kill skills or magical abilities.

[h2]Multiplayer[/h2]

But most importantly - in Daldos there is a multiplayer, which is the main mode of the game.
We have already conducted internal testing within the team and calibrated it for full operation.

In the near future, some of you will be able to get access to testing the game yourself.

This is very cool and inspires us!
Stay in touch and stay tuned. And don't forget to add the game to your playlists!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40311623/8038824ec15e818c4992ac932717d6fd1c160bfa.jpg[/img]

notes.title: New characters
notes.content:
Our artists have finished the concepts of new characters for the harsh Vikings.

[h3]The first one is [b]archer [/b]. [/h3]

An excellent hunter, an excellent tracker, a high-class shooter - he will help you achieve victory with high accuracy!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40311623/934213e86a5236f1e44ffb15ad94bec06c15ee1f.png[/img]

[h3]Another newcomer is [b]seidman[/b]. [/h3]

Who are the Seidmans? These are the Scandinavian shamans.
Magical powers are coming to the battlefield!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40311623/96c1b9b49f50214eeacf7ed393ea21d3a4bf0d11.jpg[/img]

Both new warriors will be added in the release version of the game.

[h3]Another new feature[/h3]

Soon, we will show you another interesting new product that can completely transform the visual of the game individually for you.


[h3]P.S.[/h3]

We do not want to mislead you, so we will immediately say that for the classic competitive game mode, this innovation will affect the dynamics of the battle, its beauty and diversity. At the same time, the game balance will not be affected, i.e. these units will not have abilities that give them an advantage over others.

However, since we plan to support the game after the release, you will be able to enjoy such things in a separate game mode.

[h3]What do you think about it?[/h3]
